subject: Request: SOC 2 Type II report, attestation timeline and UK/EU data transfer clarifications
messages:
From: Alice Byrne <alice.byrne@finserve.com>
To: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai
Cc: security@finserve.com
Date: Mon, 26 Jul 2027 09:12:00 +0000
Subject: SOC 2 Type II + UK/EU hosting + attestation window

Hi Vanessa —

Thanks for taking this. As part of our procurement security review we need the following to move to legal: 

1) A copy of your most recent SOC 2 Type II report (preferably the full report, not just an attestation).
2) Confirmation of the audit period covered by that report and whether there is any overlap gap if Redwood moves from Hosted to Dedicated during Q3 (we have internal audit in early August).
3) Does Redwood have a bridge/attestation letter that confirms data residency commitments and cross-border transfer handling for UK/EU customers while audit windows are in flight?
4) A CAIQ or SIG-lite mapping would be useful; alternatively a pointer to your security portal where we can pull it.
5) Any short description of encryption at rest/key management for EU-region deployments (KMS details) and whether keys are customer-managed or provider-managed.

We are trying to avoid legal delay — can you get the SOC 2 PDF and a short summary back by EOD Wed (28 July)? If you need to loop in anyone from Redwood infra or compliance please do.

Best,
Alice Byrne
Head of Security Operations
FinServe Ltd

Attachments: none

From: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Byrne <alice.byrne@finserve.com>
Cc: security@finserve.com, karthik.iyer@redwood.ai
Date: Mon, 26 Jul 2027 13:05:00 +0000
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II + UK/EU hosting + attestation window

Hi Alice —

Thanks — I can take point on this. Short answers up front, full packet attached in follow-up: 

- SOC 2 Type II: we will provide the full SOC 2 Type II report (June 30, 2027 coverage).
- Audit period: the report covers the period 2026-07-01 through 2027-06-30. If your audit is in early August, there is no overlap gap with our latest Type II; any transition from Hosted to Dedicated does not change the underlying control environment documented in the report, but it may require an operational runbook for migration timing.
- Bridge letter/attestation: we do provide a short attestation (we call it an "attestation letter") for customers who need temporary residency assurances during supplier audits; it states our commitments on data handling and export controls during audit windows.
- CAIQ/SIG: we host a CAIQ-plus mapping on our security portal — I'll include the export PDF.
- KMS/encryption: EU-region deployments use provider-managed KMS by default; customer-managed keys (Bring Your Own Key) are available for Private deployments (Redwood Private) with HSM-backed KMS integrations.

I'll attach: SOC2_TypeII_2027-06-30.pdf, redwood-dataflow-diagram-2027-07.png, and a one-page attestation letter template you can use for procurement. 

I will also loop in Karthik for timeline and Marissa for legal/DPA sign-off in case you want a formal bridge letter.

Talk soon —
Vanessa Ortiz
VP, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference

Attachments (stubs): SOC2_TypeII_2027-06-30.pdf (document), redwood-dataflow-diagram-2027-07.png (image), signed-DPA-FinServe-2027-07-27.pdf (pdf stub to be delivered)

Subject: Quick follow-up on KMS and residency wording

Vanessa —

Two quick clarifying points from procurement/security: 

- Can the attestation explicitly say that logs and metadata for EU/UK customers remain within the EU region by default (unless otherwise agreed)? We need that language to close our internal whistle-stop review.
- For the BYOK option, is there a standard design we can surface to our infra team (key rotation, HSM vendor, fallback during failover)? A short bullet list is fine.

If you can add a one-paragraph excerpt for each we can include it in the procurement questionnaire.

Thanks,
Dan Hughes
Senior Procurement Manager
Procure-Tech (on behalf of FinServe)

Attachments: none

From: vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Byrne <alice.byrne@finserve.com>, Dan Hughes <dan.hughes@procure-tech.co.uk>
Cc: karthik.iyer@redwood.ai, marissa.cole@redwood.ai, sofia.ivanova@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 28 Jul 2027 17:03:00 +0000
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II + UK/EU hosting + attestation window — attachments and excerpt

Team —

I've attached the SOC 2 Type II report and the dataflow diagram; below are the two short excerpts you requested that procurement/security can drop into their questionnaire or attestation: 

1) Residency / logs & metadata (one-paragraph excerpt):
"By default, production customer data, operational logs, and request metadata for customers who select EU or UK region deployments are stored in the corresponding regional data stores and are not exported outside the specified region. Standard backups are stored in-region; cross-region replication only occurs where explicitly configured by the customer for DR purposes and under contractual agreement."

2) BYOK / KMS (bullet excerpt):
- BYOK available for Redwood Private and Dedicated instances; customer keys can be provisioned to our supported HSM partners.
- Key rotation: customers may define rotation cadence; Redwood supports automated rotation workflows or manual rotation hooks.
- Fallback: in a failover to secondary region, keys continue to be used only if the customer has authorized cross-region key replication; otherwise a transient emergency-access process is followed with audit and customer notification.
- HSM vendors: AWS KMS with custom key store, Google Cloud HSM (Cloud KMS) integrations, and Azure Key Vault managed HSM supported.

Next steps and asks from Redwood: 
- Please confirm if the attestation letter template suffices; if so we can sign and return the formal bridge letter by tomorrow morning.
- Karthik will draft the short BYOK architecture snippet if you want a diagram (looping him in).
- Marissa will confirm any DPA cross-border wording changes — Marissa, can you flag anything material?

Thanks, and happy to hop on a 20-min call if that helps close this quickly.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
VP, Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
